records.text: Tamsin's greenhouse is heated by a propane burner. The thermostat is set to twelve degrees.
Tamsin's dog is a whippet named Juniper. She was adopted from the Fenwick shelter.
Rohan's greenhouse grows chillies. He waters them before dawn.
Ines's mentor teaches ceramics at the Larkhill studio. They meet on alternate Thursdays.
Ines's nephew is learning the trumpet. His first concert is in March.
Tamsin's cousin works at a bakery in Dundee. The bakery opens at six.
The lab freezer is a Frostline FL-80. Its alarm threshold is minus seventy.
The staff kitchen fridge was defrosted in April.
Priyanka edits her notes in Obsidian. Her diagrams are drawn in Excalidraw.
Felix writes his reports in LibreOffice Writer.
Project Heron holds its retrospective at the Granary Hall on February 9.
Project Heron is led by Soraya and Matteo. They publish a fortnightly digest.
Project Kestrel's kickoff is at the Tannery Loft on January 22.
Project Kestrel is steered by Anneliese. She insists on written decisions.
The harvest fair opens Saturday. Stall bookings close on Thursday.
The tide clock in the lobby was recalibrated. The brass face was polished.
The repository builds with a Makefile that wraps the test runner.
Rohan's kayak has a carbon paddle. The spray deck was replaced in May.

The spring field trip visited the Ardmore quarry, the Linton bog and the Carse estuary. Lunch was at the quarry cafe. The bog walk was cut short by rain. Samples from the estuary were labelled in blue. The coach driver was called Dougal. Everyone was back by six.
Ines drives a grey hatchback. The rear wiper needs a new blade.
Tamsin's greenhouse used to be heated by paraffin. That heater was sold in 2024.
The office plants are watered on Mondays. The fern sits by the north window.
